summary: Read-modify-write of the AI control flag bitset at this+0x48BC (this[4655]): when a2 is nonzero, set bit 0 (value OR 1) to mark the vehicle AI-controlled; when zero, clear bit 0 (value AND 0xFFFFFFFE). Stores the result back at +0x48BC and returns it. Invoked from CollisionContactIteration (0x00460DD0) to release (0) or retain (1) AI override during collision contact handling.

local_names.a2: control request: nonzero = set AI-control bit 0, zero = clear it
local_names.v2: prior flag value read from this+0x48BC
local_names.result: updated flag value written back and returned

operations.description: Load the current AI control flag: v2 = this[4655] (int at this+0x48BC)
Branch on a2: nonzero selects the set-bit path, zero selects the clear-bit path
Set path: result = v2 | 1, forcing bit 0 to 1 (AI-controlled)
Clear path: result = v2 & 0xFFFFFFFE, forcing bit 0 to 0 (AI released)
Store the computed value back: this[4655] = result at +0x48BC
Called by CollisionContactIteration (0x00460DD0) during collision contact response to toggle the AI override flag
